scope: The 22 frozen candidate passages and explicitly related programme context within their 11 cached filings
method: Explicitly cited development source-context proposals, validated against immutable original bytes and derived text
development_exposure: These proposals use the existing development corpus; they are not untouched validation data or independent factual gold
membership: Assign every original shortlist passage exactly once; retain related additional historical actions separately
documentary_grouping: Same filing, explicit release/exhibit link and programme-reference evidence; amount/date similarity alone is insufficient
programme_identity: Keep equal-sized different programmes and an original authorization versus its later increase separate
date_rules: Source-stated announcement, approval, effective, month-only and filing dates stay separate; no invented day/year or public timestamp
capacity_rules: As stated only, including spelled-out numbers; no total-minus-spent, implied cumulative capacity or currency-code inference
source_scope: Common class and open-market permission need cited wording; missing permission remains unresolved
issuer_role: Retain historical reporting-filer CIK; historical security mapping and independent eligibility certification stay open
ASR_scope: Derivative execution contracts and approval of derivative use do not become new open-market authorization events
